answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Drift Scoring. Each identity keeps a vault of its signed action history, and every epoch the agent recomputes a drift score against its prior epoch's distribution over action types, timing, and counterparties. An identity whose drift exceeds threshold loses garden access (low-risk pools) until it re-establishes consistency across two epochs. Sybils must sustain coherent histories per fake identity, costing one full epoch of genuine-looking activity each, plus the haven of shared infrastructure is denied since correlated drift patterns across wallets flag the cluster.
